propositions: The module-size gate aborts with exit 1 when the allowlist has no non-comment entries because grep returns exit 1 under bash -e -o pipefail.
The fix guards the listed= grep with '|| true' in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml so a no-match grep does not abort the step.
With a drained comment-only allowlist and no over-cap files, the gate should run to completion, print 'Module-size gate: OK', and exit 0.
The gate must still fail (exit 1) when a non-allow-listed file exceeds 800 LOC.
The two workflow gate step bodies diverge in error-printout lines and are intentionally left unharmonized by this change.
The parity test asserts the 'Module-size gate' step is present in both workflows without diffing bodies and stays green.
